anomalies.observed: The nets named UART3_TX_FCC and UART3_RX_FCC connect the UART3 connector pins to FCC1 pins 48 and 73, which the netlist identifies as VCAP pins.
anomalies.expected: The MCU VCAP pins require their specified capacitors to ground; they must not be routed to UART connector signal pins. UART3 signals should use MCU UART-capable I/O pins.
anomalies.impact: The VCAP pins are incorrectly loaded by external connector signals instead of being properly decoupled, risking failure of the MCU's internal core supply; the UART3 connector also cannot provide the intended UART interface.

anomalies.observed: HSE1 connects to FCC1 pins 5 and 37, identified as PE6 and PE7, rather than the MCU's PH0/PH1 oscillator pins. HSE2 has no connection to NAVC1: its crystal network is separate, while NAVC1 pins 5 and 6 (PH0/PH1) connect to capacitor-only nets.
anomalies.expected: Each 25 MHz HSE crystal network should connect to the corresponding MCU's HSE oscillator input and output pins, with the appropriate load network.
anomalies.impact: Neither MCU has the specified crystal correctly connected to its HSE oscillator pins, so the external clock source will not function as intended.
